title: Role and construction contracts for contextual buttons

scope.purpose: Choose and verify context-appropriate control anatomy without changing protected task meaning.
scope.specimens: Original authored baseline/treatment fixtures with shared local content/state/handlers.
scope.execution: Network-disabled local simulation; no production requests or mutations.
scope.golf: Isolated authored proposal informed by an observed entry-control audit; no production handler, room server or course parity claim.

decision_order: assign local rank, hazard, presentation and context separately
name required change and preserved axes
implement only supported states and input
fill before to intent to rendered ledger

contexts.preserve: same web fixture/content/handler for before and after
same app fixture/content/handler for before and after
same original local scene/content/handler for before and after
room-creation label/meaning in isolated proposal; no production behavior claimed

roles.meaning: The supported next commitment in a local task group
semantic_contract: native button for command; link when the action is navigation
rank is scoped to the task group, not the whole product
visual_contract: strongest appropriate surface, placement or scale in its group
no compulsory icon, body or bevel

state_applicability.pending: only for a real or explicitly simulated operation
state_applicability.disabled: only for an actual unavailable condition
state_applicability.selected: not applicable unless the control is also a genuine toggle/selection

roles.meaning: A meaningful alternative, back, cancel or supporting command
semantic_contract: native button for command; link for navigation
cancel does not imply destructive consequence
visual_contract: quieter but discoverable member of the context family
readable target/label and independent focus

state_applicability.pending: only if its actual action waits

roles.meaning: Low-priority help, inspect or lightweight utility command
semantic_contract: native button for command; link for location change
visual_contract: flat or text-only is valid
do not hide essential label or reduce readability to establish rank

state_applicability.hover: optional feedback when pointer input supported
state_applicability.selected: only if also a genuine toggle

roles.meaning: An action presented primarily as a glyph
semantic_contract: named button/link according to meaning
decorative glyphs do not add redundant naming
visual_contract: optical glyph mass and corner/stroke grammar fit the family
visible art may be smaller than fixed target
visible label/context when recognition is insufficient

state_applicability.hover: when pointer input supported; tooltip is supplementary
state_applicability.selected: only if also a genuine toggle/choice

roles.meaning: An action removing or consequentially changing specified state
semantic_contract: hazard is independent of primary/secondary/tertiary rank
preserve existing confirmation and recovery policy
visual_contract: precise consequential verb/object plus appropriate hazard treatment
reuse family grammar; no compulsory modal/icon/hold/red cancel

semantic_contract: native checkbox/switch or toggle button according to modeled setting
aria-pressed toggle label retains its identity across values
changing action labels require an explicitly different command model
visual_contract: static on/off mark or text distinct from focus/press
shared target/silhouette across values unless a bounded reason is recorded

roles.meaning: One value selected from a small exclusive set
semantic_contract: prefer native radio inputs for exclusive choice
group has a name and each option has a label
preserve documented arrow/selection behavior; toolbar radio is a distinct case
visual_contract: aligned shared group grammar
checked mark/face distinct from focused option
not a row of competing primary commands

state_applicability.pending: normally not applicable unless selection persistence waits

roles.meaning: A control revealing an associated local content panel
semantic_contract: tablist/tab/tabpanel links and selected state agree
preserve documented automatic or manual activation policy
roving focus follows the selected supported pattern
visual_contract: active rail/lip or panel relationship
independent focus mark
quiet surface can remain flat

state_applicability.pending: only if actual panel operation waits

roles.meaning: A link changing URL, route or meaningful location
semantic_contract: native anchor with actual destination
aria-current when appropriate; no generic aria-selected on route links
visual_contract: link/navigation grammar may be flat
persistent current marker differs from focus and hover
stronger fill allowed when navigation is the next task step

state_applicability.pending: only if actual route workflow exposes it
state_applicability.disabled: requires an explicit unavailable navigation contract

roles.meaning: A control opening a compact disclosure or true command menu
semantic_contract: button exposes expansion and relation to revealed content
aria-haspopup menu only for a real menu pattern
preserve Escape/close/focus return as applicable
visual_contract: recognizable named trigger
chevron/more glyph only when it communicates the actual behavior

roles.meaning: A compact command, option, submenu trigger or navigation item
semantic_contract: choose button/link/selection semantics by row meaning
menu roles require complete menu keyboard contract
ordinary navigation lists and disclosures are not automatically ARIA menus
visual_contract: quiet aligned row with label and optional glyph/check/shortcut columns
trailing chevron/check has real meaning
no primary extrusion for every row

roles.meaning: A command coexisting with gameplay, resources, status or binding prompts
semantic_contract: separate actionable commands from read-only meters/status
binding glyph/hold threshold reflect actual supported input
HUD context does not grant every item button semantics
visual_contract: family fits actual game art/equipment/material
main command can be tactile while HUD/menu stays low relief
cost/cooldown/condition remains readable

state_applicability.pending: only for real or explicitly simulated unfinished action

anatomy: optional calm backing or state rail
families.exception: A primary may be flat when task/context makes it sufficiently identifiable.

trial_recipe.origin: authored trial, not universal or source measured

families.exception: An outline can be primary in a suitable hierarchy.

trial_recipe.origin: authored trial, not universal or source measured

families.exception: Fill conveys emphasis, not automatically pending/selected/destructive semantics.

trial_recipe.origin: authored trial, not universal or source measured

families.exception: Keep dense data/menu rows quiet unless their role needs elevation.

trial_recipe.origin: authored trial, not universal or source measured

families.exception: Not required for all game controls; utilities and meters can remain low relief.

trial_recipe.origin: authored trial, not universal or source measured

families.exception: No universal polygon, hologram, paper, icon, bevel, font or color; do not copy branded source artwork.

trial_recipe.origin: derive from actual scene/art and bounded brief; no universal measurements

rules: longest supported label and mixed scripts fit without hiding essential meaning
icon canvas is distinct from visible glyph bounds
tactile press leaves outer target/focus shell and sibling layout stationary
loaded font and actual glyphs are verified beyond computed weight
full width, equal width and icons require contextual reasons

units.rule: Record origin and units for each value; do not treat artwork pixels, device pixels and CSS pixels as interchangeable.

state_contract.applicability: Use only states supported by actual role/model or explicitly identified simulation. No state-sheet completion mandate.

meanings.pressed: momentary held activation feedback, not persistent selection
meanings.selected_on_current: persistent choice/value/location appropriate to semantic role
meanings.pending: operation has begun and not settled
meanings.disabled_unavailable: action cannot run for a real documented condition

composition: actual model gates activation before visual classes
hover/press do not erase persistent meaning
focus is independent and remains visible
pending suppresses duplicate commitment and settles truthfully
state_contract.native_disabled: Normally removed from keyboard Tab sequence and suppresses activation; reason must be reachable elsewhere.
state_contract.aria_disabled: Expresses unavailability but requires actual activation guards when kept focusable.
state_contract.reduced_motion: Remove interpolation/travel animation while retaining static state, text and focus feedback.
input_checks: Enter/Space native command activation without duplicates
reset/context change while local operation pending

change_ledger_contract.structural_failure_rule: Color/background/font-only work fails when the brief names unimplemented silhouette, face/body, glyph or internal-layout changes.
change_ledger_contract.flat_exception: Intentional flat/no-body/text-only construction can pass when the role and brief justify it and the rendered/behavior contract passes.
change_ledger_contract.preservation: Record deliberate unchanged axes and authorized copy/layout/behavior changes separately; do not require every axis to change.

minimum_for_visual_change: matching contextual screen and component crops
actual runtime values where cascade/geometry matters
separation_rules: authored recipes do not report runtime measurements
structural pass is not browser input pass
desktop narrow viewport is not physical phone testing
local simulator pass is not production parity
screenshot review is not user approval or measured usability gain
authored baseline/treatment is not generated experimental output
evidence_contract.production_action_rule: Do not call live services, create public rooms, upload, publish or spend resources to collect evidence for these fixtures.

maintenance_contract.tokens: specimens/tokens.css owns shared token meanings and basic shell defaults.
maintenance_contract.families: specimens/families.css scopes context/treatment visual grammar and state appearance.
maintenance_contract.semantics: specimens/semantics.mjs owns local model/selection keyboard behavior.
maintenance_contract.render: specimens/render.mjs imports shared action/selection components and owns context composition, labels and local action binding.
maintenance_contract.golf: specimens/golf.html and specimens/golf.css remain isolated from global web/app families.
maintenance_contract.regression: Follow actual dependencies: shared tokens across inheriting families, shared handler across importing roles, local family across affected context/states.
maintenance_contract.restriction: No installation, deployment, publication or production mutation is authorized by this contract.
maintenance_contract.actions: specimens/components/actions.mjs owns shared action markup and original decorative glyphs.
maintenance_contract.selection: specimens/components/selection.mjs owns shared tab markup and panel-link attributes.
maintenance_contract.change_ledger: records/change-ledger.json records the actual required-change rows and evidence status.
maintenance_contract.browser_report: BROWSER_REPORT.md separates executed checks from blockers and unverified rendering.

references.kind: existing creator/observation/proposal research; historical states not assumed shipping
target minimum and exceptions, not ideal/universal specimen dimension
primary text contrast guidance with exceptions; recipe sizes remain authored trials
